# 3Parusa — bespoke sailing tours on catamarans

> 3Parusa runs bespoke tours on VIP catamarans worldwide. Captain Stas Kochukov (IYT/ICC licensed, 20,000+ nautical miles, 100+ tours in 20+ countries). A holiday that makes you forget hotels: a new bay every day, hotel-grade ensuite cabins, a hand-matched crew.

## Key facts
- Boat: VIP catamaran 100-150 m2, 4 double ensuite cabins, up to 8 guests, WiFi 60 GB.
- Destinations: Turkey (Fethiye, Gocek, Marmaris), Greece (Cyclades, Mykonos, Athens), Croatia, Italy (Sardinia), France (Cote d'Azur), Spain (Ibiza), Seychelles, Thailand, Caribbean, Mexico.
- Formats: shared week tour, family, private (romantic/stag/hen/wedding), corporate and business retreat, kids sailing camp, captain mentorship, B2B broker (260+ charter companies).

## Prices (2026)
- A cabin berth — from EUR 1,100 / week.
- A private cabin (for two) — from EUR 2,200 / week.
- The whole yacht (up to 8 guests) — from EUR 6,700 / week.
- Premium destinations (Seychelles, Caribbean) — from EUR 12,000 / week.
- Included: cabin, curated route, captain, linen/towels, WiFi 60GB, airport-marina transfer, 24/7 support. Extra: flights, boat kitty (EUR 150-250/person/week), deposit ~EUR 500 (or insurance ~EUR 330), chef EUR 1200, photographer EUR 1000.
